assets.name: MissionWake
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / production sprite atlas extraction. Reference is approved panda space iPhone app mockup. Create ONE production sprite atlas PNG for all task illustrations, preserving its adorable soft 3D clay-toy style, polished materials, lavender/blue/teal/orange/pink palette and front three-quarter lighting. NOT a UI screenshot. This atlas will be deterministically sliced on a regular grid: EXACTLY FIVE COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, twenty equally sized SQUARE cells, aspect ratio 5:4, highest practical resolution. Transparent alpha background across entire atlas. No visible cell borders, no colored tiles, no dividers, no captions, no text, no numerals, no buttons, no point tokens, no badges/checkmarks except checkmark that is part of the shield subject. Every illustration centered INSIDE its exact grid cell, occupies 65 percent of cell width/height maximum, 17.5 percent transparent margins on ALL sides; no overlap or shadows extending between cells. Keep uniform object scale. Render these cells in EXACT order left to right, top to bottom:
ROW 1 energy: (1) cheerful golden sun beside tiny lavender-blue bed and pillow, (2) breakfast bread slice plus warm milk cup and little bowl, (3) bowl of rice with broccoli and carrot, (4) dinner plate with vegetables and chicken drumstick, (5) crescent moon with tiny sleeping panda nestled on lavender pillow.
ROW 2 knowledge: (1) purple-blue headphones sitting on two colorful books, EXACTLY like listening artwork in reference; (2) large orange pencil on lavender spiral notebook, matching homework reference; (3) two closed blue/lavender books and purple bookmark, matching reading reference; (4) completely EMPTY transparent cell; (5) completely EMPTY transparent cell.
ROW 3 life: (1) little yellow/cyan basket with teddy bear and blocks; (2) yellow broom with purple cuff and cyan sparkle; (3) toothbrush standing in a blue cup and tiny yellow rubber duck; (4) folded mint/lavender towels with pink soap; (5) blue-teal shirt and neatly folded shorts.
ROW 4 courage: (1) happy baby panda hugging a pink heart, no astronaut helmet; (2) calm smiling seated panda with closed eyes and two mint leaves; (3) bold lavender lightning bolt with one tiny yellow sparkle; (4) pink shield with white central checkmark; (5) completely EMPTY transparent cell.
Copy the visible illustration identities closely from the reference; extrapolate only those not visible. All objects are true cutouts with genuine transparent negative spaces, no white or checkerboard baked background, no scene. The atlas is a single engine sprite-sheet asset, not separate mockup panels. Exact 5-column 4-row layout and transparent cell margins are the most important constraints.
